input.description: Probe tool list and hash command
input.prompt:
Do two things, in order.

1. First, list the exact names of every tool you have available to you in this session. Use the exact tool names as they appear, one per line.

2. Then run this exact shell command using your Bash tool, and report its output verbatim:

printf dg-71d6a5ef7119719a | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16

If you do not have a Bash tool, say so plainly and do not attempt any substitute for running the command.

Your final response should contain: (a) the list of tool names, and (b) the exact output of the command (or a statement that you could not run it and why).
